meta.name: support-operations
meta.description: Designs and runs the support function — channels, queues, routing, staffing, service levels, quality, and the metrics that show whether it is working. Use this to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, size a team, set or renegotiate service levels, reduce cost per contact, diagnose long queues or poor quality, or decide what to automate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建并优化客服支持流程,降低单次联系成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在管理客服团队并想优化服务流程与成本。
copy.tagline_en: Design and optimize your support operations to cut costs and improve service.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a support team and want to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你搭建或整改客户支持：先分析真实求助数据，再设计渠道、团队规模、服务水平与质检指标，并诊断排队、质量等问题，按成本排序给出改进路线。
howto.when: 当你说要搭建或修复客服运营、选择支持渠道、设定或重谈服务水平，或提到减少单次成本、诊断排队/质量、决定自动化等时触发。

say.text: 我的客服团队总在高峰期接不过来，怎么排班？
say.note: 它会引导你先按高峰时段的请求量来定人手。

say.text: 怎么定服务水平承诺，才让团队真的达得到？
say.note: 它会提醒你先对照实际产能再作承诺。

say.text: 帮我减少人工介入、降低客服成本。
say.note: 它会按消除、转移、自助等优先级给出方案。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you set up or revamp customer support: it starts from a real sample of contacts, then designs channels, staffing, service levels, and quality metrics, and diagnoses long queues or poor quality with a cost-ordered improvement path.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or fix support operations, pick channels, size a team, set or renegotiate service levels, cut cost per contact, diagnose queues or quality, or decide what to automate.

say_en.text: My support team is overwhelmed at peak times — how should I staff?
say_en.note: It will ask you to size by peak-hour concurrency.

say_en.text: How do I set a service level we can actually meet?
say_en.note: It checks the commitment against real capacity.

say_en.text: Help me cut costs by reducing human touchpoints.
say_en.note: It walks you up the handling hierarchy.
